content: TypeScript 7.0 (Go-native compiler) went GA 2026-07-08; npm dist-tag latest=7.0.2. It ships WITHOUT a stable programmatic compiler API (targeted for 7.1, autumn 2026). Verified against npm registry: typescript-eslint@8.67.0 declares peerDependency typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' — i.e. TS7 is NOT usable with typescript-eslint. ESLint core, ts-jest, ts-morph, Vue/Svelte/Astro template checkers are all blocked. Last TS6 release is 6.0.3 (2026-04-16). Practical guidance for a greenfield Node/TS OSS project in Aug 2026: either (a) pin TypeScript 6.0.3 and keep typescript-eslint, or (b) adopt TS 7.0.2 and use oxlint (Rust) + tsgolint for type-aware rules (tsgolint v7 tracks TS 7.0.2 and covers 59/61 typescript-eslint type-aware rules; declared stable 2026-07-22).
